leadText:
Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Ginji's Rescue Team (Japanese: ポケモン不思議のダンジョンギンジの救助隊) is a six-part by 溝渕誠 Makoto Mizobuchi based on Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team. It follows the adventures of Ginji, a reckless boy who is turned into a and forms a rescue team with a cautious .

For the manga's English translated release, it was originally syndicated in Nintendo Power 207-212 (September 2006 - February 2007) in North America and Jetix Magazine in the United Kingdom. It was later released in a collected volume by VIZ Media.

Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Ginji's Rescue Team (Japanese: ポケモン不思議のダンジョンギンジの救助隊) is a six-part by 溝渕誠 Makoto Mizobuchi based on Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team. It follows the adventures of Ginji, a reckless boy who is turned into a and forms a rescue team with a cautious .

For the manga's English translated release, it was originally syndicated in Nintendo Power 207-212 (September 2006 - February 2007) in North America and Jetix Magazine in the United Kingdom. It was later released in a collected volume by VIZ Media.

==Publications==
 
 
 

==Chapters==
 

==International translations==
 
In , Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Ginji's Rescue Team was translated by Glénat as . It was serialised in the official Nintendo Magazine and was later published as two collected volumes, each containing three chapters.

Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Ginji's Rescue Team was also translated to Dutch in , also available in Flanders (Dutch-speaking Belgium) at the time, as . It was serialised in Jetix Magazine in three issues, as separate small booklets.

==Trivia==
 
This was the first Pokémon manga published by VIZ Media to retain the right-to-left Japanese reading format. All Pokémon titles published since have also been published in the original Japanese format.
This is the only Pokémon manga that has been published by VIZ Media, but not by Chuang Yi.
This was only Pokémon manga to have been translated into Dutch until the release of Pokemon: Het Grote Avontuur Volume 1 in 2023.

===Errors===
In the Dutch version, a very small printed line was accidentally left in English.
